_comment: Ground truth for tooling boundaries, maintained by people; eo_tooling_audit reads but never rewrites it.
ecosystem.json remains the authority for repositories and footings. These entries are tools and artifacts, not additional projects or membership decisions.

Foundation repositories such as cvc5 are included as tooling providers. Path and coverage findings describe our inventory; they impose no policy obligations on those repositories. Outsiders remain outside this audit.

repo names the containing repository. Optional owner names a child project in that repository; it defaults to repo. path and also list implementation or artifact directories relative to repo, within the owner's root.

kind defaults to tool, including executable programs and importable libraries. A tool's entrypoints can be command launchers or public library modules. An artifact is a maintained output such as a bug database or tutorial; it needs content files rather than code entrypoints.

entrypoints, files and docs are file paths relative to repo, including shared launchers and docs outside the owner. They are inspected, never executed. Empty required lists are allowed and reported as gaps.
layout_note explains a departure from one self-contained top-level directory within the owning repository or child project. Such departures are advisory, never policy failures.
Document artifacts can live in their owner's reserved docs/ directory without a layout gap. Their recorded content and documentation paths are still checked.

exclude is keyed by repository or child owner and maps directories relative to that owner's root to reasons. Each explicit exclusion is displayed and counts as non-compliant inventory coverage, not a silent waiver. Reserved docs, scripts, test, tests, examples, cmake, include, licenses, prompts, deps, scratch, tools and hidden directories are not discovery candidates; see docs/policy.md's layout table.

Discovery considers tracked top-level directories in repositories and child owners named here. Other nested tools and implementations in shared directories need explicit entries. Research charters alone are not tooling.

Initial inventory read from local working trees on 2026-09-19: anoieu 06bd787, dokimasia 158c385, epikrisis e748ff6, ethos 21fc6c7d, eudaimonia 79dd601, kanon f22798f, koine 74ea664, logos e8fa2441, paideia 7b305f1, tachyon cccb1b2; iogos has staged files but no first commit. Local changes may be present.

cvc5's entries were read from its clean checkout at a07d513075 on 2026-09-19. Logos's installer was read at e8fa2441; it regenerates from a supplied or cached signature and does not automatically track the latest cvc5.
Paideia's bootcamp tutorial was read at 7ccb92d on 2026-09-19; its source-baseline page records the cvc5 revision and validation limits of the tutorial itself.

Eunoia's artifacts were read at 302af2c on 2026-09-19: mimesis owns the tutorials and case studies, sapheneia the language account and comparison ledgers. Their documents are explicitly recorded under each child's docs/; examples/ retains its reserved purpose.

Ethos's formatter was read at 92e6563b on 2026-09-19; its source supplies a docstring and CLI help. That working tree has the smtlibTests/ files staged under tests/smtlib/, so the old directory's exclusion is removed.

The audit compares paths and coverage with current local trees or GitHub default branches. Descriptions and tool boundaries remain human readings; presence does not establish correctness or installation.

cvc5.what: SMT solver, library APIs and proof production

cvc5_proof_tools.what: Installs proof checkers and checks CPC/Logos compatibility
cvc5_proof_tools.layout_note: proof-checker setup and compatibility scripts share contrib/ with other development utilities

anoieu_bug_db.what: Persistent analyzer and fuzzer findings and browsing view

anoieu_analyzer.what: Static analysis of Eunoia signatures and semantics

anoieu_fuzz.what: Generates and mutates inputs for proof checkers

policy_check.what: Repository policy checks and documentation currency

dokimasia_analyzer.what: Analyzes gaps in cvc5 proof production

dokimasia_bug_db.what: Persistent proof-production findings and browsing view

history_analyzer.what: Audits repository histories at recorded revisions

loc_analyzer.what: Counts implementation and documentation in Git trees

epikrisis_site.what: Builds the shared history and repository-size report site
epikrisis_site.layout_note: shared site builder lives in bin/ rather than its own named tool directory

ethos_checker.what: C++ checker for Eunoia proof calculi

ethos_formatter.what: Formats Eunoia signatures, with check and diff modes
ethos_formatter.layout_note: formatter shares contrib/ with compilation scripts and DRAT utilities

ethos_eoc.what: Compiles Eunoia calculi to checkers and proof obligations
ethos_eoc.layout_note: Python driver is under tools/eoc/; C++ implementation is shared across plugins/

ethos_cpp_compiler.what: Compiles signatures into a custom Ethos binary
ethos_cpp_compiler.layout_note: experimental compiler is a plugin below plugins/

new_checker.what: Generates a calculus-specific Lean checker project
new_checker.layout_note: generator implementation is split between scripts/new-checker.sh and templates/

euthyna_site.what: Builds interactive proof-measurement reports from snapshots
euthyna_site.layout_note: site builder, renderer and tests share analysis/ with measurement tooling and vendored scripts; the shared launcher lives in bin/

mimesis_tutorials.what: Tutorials and case studies for Eunoia signatures and Logos verification

sapheneia_account.what: Eunoia language account and comparison ledgers; not authoritative

stathmos_audits.what: Audits ecosystem status and available tooling

bug_db_manager.what: Shared tooling for owners to append to their bug databases

eo_cmd.what: Shared ecosystem commands and assistant workflow launchers

logos_checker.what: CPC checker and proofs; logos and logos-native front ends

logos_cpcmini.what: Reduced CPC checker library and proofs; no standalone CLI

logos_parser.what: Shared s-expression reader and proof-parser library

logos_installer.what: Regenerates and checks Logos against a supplied CPC signature

paideia_bootcamp.what: Tutorial for navigating and developing cvc5, with exercises

job_launcher.what: Validates, launches and retrieves remote benchmark jobs

iogos_checker.what: Experimental generated Isabelle/HOL checker and obligations

stats_profiler.what: Profiles cvc5 statistics with offline reports and plots

euthyna.bin: Shared measurement and site launcher; bin/euthyna is recorded as a site entry point.
euthyna.data: Committed measurement snapshots consumed by the report site; input evidence rather than site implementation.
